text:
alex: Quick sync: yesterday's A/B rollout for text-gen-202 had weird tail latency for a subset of tenants. Need to decide whether we handle this via session-level quarantine or request-level routing.

maya: Observed pattern: new sessions routed to variant-B saw cold KV cache misses and latency spikes, but most requests that hit warmed-up state were fine.

dan: So root cause is warmup / prefix cache distribution, not model correctness. If we evict sessions immediately we lose affinity.

leah: For tenant-bound features (pinned variants) we can't easily migrate state. Eviction would break ongoing interactions. We should default to request-level fallback for pinned tenants.

cheng: Agree. Proposal: add a per-tenant policy flag `allow_session_migration: true/false` in the rollout manifest. Routers check the flag before any soft-evict.

alex: If migration is disallowed, router should instead map requests to a compatible variant (via coordinator compatibility matrix) and add a `X-fallback-reason` header for observability.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary 3621007000 for text-gen-202 (variant B) started in us-east-1.

maya: Also: to avoid oscillation, introduce a probe-credit model. Canary starts with N credits. Each failing probe decrements. Credits decay slowly so transient spikes don't kill the canary.

dan: What about fast local decisions? Routers need to react within 200ms to protect SLOs. Coordinator round-trips are too slow for transient failures.

leah: Local fast-path + centralized finalization seems best. Router takes provisional action (route new sessions to fallback) and writes an event to the coordinator stream. Coordinator then can auto-escalate or retract after seeing cluster-wide signals.

cheng: Implementation note: make provisional actions idempotent and time-bounded. Use event types: `provisional_quarantine`, `quarantine_extend`, `quarantine_rescind`, `final_quarantine`. Include `origin_router_id` and `provisional_expiry_ts` in events.

maya: Good. We should also include a small pre-warm phase in the orchestration: create a synthetic warmup runner that replays common prefix requests to seed KV caches on canary replicas before sending live traffic. Toggle via `pre_warm: true`.

d an: Spell out hysteresis: on re-attach attempts, use exponentially increasing cool-down windows (e.g., 30s, 60s, 180s). Also introduce jitter to avoid synchronized retries across routers.

leah: For A/B metrics, expose `quarantine_budget` per model in coordinator: percentage of active sessions that can be in provisional quarantine concurrently. If budget exhausted, routers should fallback to request-level hedging instead of quarantining new sessions.

ops-bot: monitor-bot: Alert suppressed — quarantine_budget at 85% for text-gen-202 in us-east-1.

cheng: For auditing and for post-mortems, persist the full decision trace: signals, rolling window stats, probe-credit levels, and action taken. Keep traces small: compressed protobuf events and index by model+region.

maya: Also add telemetry tags for `kv_fill_rate`, `prefix_miss_ratio`, `session_creation_rps`, `probe_latency` and `decision_score`. Downstream evals can reconstruct decision thresholds.

d an: Edge case: mixture of canaries and shadowing. If we mirror traffic, the mirror should be excluded from handoff decisions unless mirror probe path also fails. Otherwise noise from mirrored requests could cause false positives.

leah: Agree. Mark mirrored traffic with `traffic_role=mirror` in telemetry and ensure it's filtered in the decision scoring pipeline.

cheng: Security/ops concern: make sure the coordinator exposes a read-only endpoint for SRE dashboards and a protected write path for emergency overrides. Emergency override should accept an audit token and be rate-limited.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pre-warm completed for text-gen-202 variant B in us-east-1.

maya: Action items: 1) Cheng/Leah - add `allow_session_migration` flag + compatibility matrix prototype. 2) Dan/Alex - implement router local provisional action + exponential backoff and jitter. 3) Maya - define minimal telemetry tags and probe-credit semantics. 4) SRE - define `quarantine_budget` default and dashboard panels.

leah: Quick note: add a unit test that simulates 100 routers making provisional_quarantine decisions with randomized jitter to ensure budget enforcement holds under scale.

alex: Thanks — will file RFC follow-up and link to the prototype branches. If everyone is good, we'll roll this into the next gated rollout. :rocket:
